description: This file defines Swagger API documentation classes for accounting rule API responses in the Apache Fineract project. It contains class definitions for response schemas used in API endpoints such as POST, PUT, and DELETE operations related to accounting rules.

classes.name: AccountingRuleApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: A container class for Swagger documentation schemas related to accounting rules API.

classes.name: PostAccountingRulesResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response when creating a new accounting rule.

classes.name: PutAccountingRulesResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response when updating an existing accounting rule.

classes.name: PutAccountingRulesResponsechangesSwagger
classes.description: Nested schema detailing changes in a put response, such as the name of the updated rule.

classes.name: DeleteAccountingRulesResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response when deleting an accounting rule.

methods.name: <constructor>
methods.description: Private constructors utilized for Swagger documentation classes to prevent instantiation.
